messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 15):
"""
Product Filing Procedure with PMC 1. Any new product or Rider or Add-on or modification of an existing Individual product or Rider or Add-on shall be approved by the Product Management Committee (PMC) of the Insurer. 2. Insurers shall file the proposed name of the product, date of approval by PMC as per the Format at Annexure-2 and shall obtain the Unique Identification Number (UIN). However, Life insurers may obtain UIN as per the procedure applicable to Life insurance products. 3. Insurers shall maintain details of the (a) individual products /Riders/Add-Ons in the specified Form - IRDAI –HIP (Annexure - 3). (b) Group products (including Government Sponsored Schemes) in the Form IRDAI-HLTGRP (Annexure-4) 4.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Which committee must approve a new health insurance product or rider before it can be launched?","answer":"The Product Management Committee (PMC) of the insurer must approve it.","facts":["Any new product or Rider or Add-on or modification of an existing Individual product or Rider or Add-on shall be approved by the Product Management Committee (PMC) of the Insurer."]},{"question":"What identification number must insurers obtain for each new health insurance product, and how is it obtained?","answer":"Insurers must obtain a Unique Identification Number (UIN) by filing the proposed name and PMC approval date as per Annexure‑2.","facts":["Insurers shall file the proposed name of the product, date of approval by PMC as per the Format at Annexure-2 and shall obtain the Unique Identification Number (UIN)."]}]}
